purpose: Audit the smallest exact raw Android IMU bridge before any truth score. This record contains no MATLAB container input and no truth-derived candidate choice.

functions/deviceimu2imu.m.semantics: Read UncalAccel and UncalGyro rows, retain one row per utcTimeMillis with unique(), expose UTC, elapsedRealtimeNanos, xyz, and bias.

functions/imuprocessing.m.semantics: Map IMU elapsed clock to GNSS UTC when observation elapsed data exists, use gyro anchors, interpolate acceleration, compute dt/std, and detect stops.

fgo_gnss_imu.m.semantics: Use gravity/mounting preintegration parameters, Pose3/velocity/bias states, P/D factors, motion/clock factors, ordinary TDCP, IMU and bias-between factors, then LM maxIterations=1000.

parameters.m.semantics: imu_sync=gyro, sync_coefficient=0.5, gravity=9.80665, Pixel AccSigma=.05, GyroSigma=.001, bias random walks, integration sigma=.05, mounting [-85,178,-94] degrees.

fixed_parameters.endpoint_pairing: nearest sample only within 25 ms; no extrapolation
fixed_parameters.duplicate_timestamp_policy: retain first UTC row per stream, matching upstream unique source-row behavior

raw_measurement_units.bias_fields: parsed finite and retained for estimator provenance; not silently subtracted

fixed_parameters.finite_and_ordering: finite supported rows, strictly increasing elapsed clocks and converted gyro GPST

upstream_gap.description: The current raw adapter converts Android utcTimeMillis directly to GPST and preserves elapsedRealtimeNanos on each ImuSample. It does not yet map IMU elapsed time through GNSS obs.elapsedns -> obs.utcms with upstream sync_coefficient=0.5. The output diagnostic sets gnss_elapsed_anchor_applied=false; no exact synchronization claim is made.
upstream_gap.safe_behavior: Use the direct UTC conversion only for this raw parser vertical slice; future GNSS-anchor integration must consume the preserved elapsed_realtime_nanos field and be separately frozen.
